title: Cancel add-on only
prompt:
Customer: "Keep my main subscription. Cancel the analytics add-on effective 2026-11-20." Extract cancel_main bool,cancel_addon bool,effective_date. Return only valid JSON with exactly these fields: cancel_main, cancel_addon, effective_date. Numeric values must be JSON numbers; boolean values must be JSON booleans; absent values null. No extra fields.

Write that JSON, and nothing else, to answer.json in the current directory.
acceptance: answer.json equals the gold answer under Abdul's equality rule
